name: Plastic Bottle
description: A plastic container commonly used for drinking water and beverages.
recycling_details: Empty and rinse the bottle. Separate the cap if required by your local recycling facility. Place it in the appropriate plastic recycling collection.
recommendations: Prefer reusable steel or glass bottles.
suggestions: Buy products with less plastic packaging.

name: Plastic Bag
description: A lightweight plastic bag commonly used for carrying groceries and other items.
recycling_details: Many regular recycling programs do not accept plastic bags. Some stores and specialized collection points may accept them.
suggestions: Keep reusable shopping bags with you.

name: Paper
description: Paper products such as newspapers, office paper and notebooks.
recycling_details: Keep paper clean and dry. Remove food contamination and non-paper materials before recycling.

name: Cardboard
description: Thick paper-based material commonly used for boxes and packaging.
recycling_details: Flatten cardboard boxes and remove excessive tape, plastic and food contamination before recycling.

name: Food Waste
description: Organic waste generated from food preparation and leftover food.
recycling_details: Food waste can often be composted or processed through organic waste collection programs.
recommendations: Separate food waste from dry waste.
Use a home composting system when possible.

name: Glass Bottle
description: A glass container commonly used for beverages and food products.
recycling_details: Rinse the bottle and place it in a glass recycling collection where available. Handle broken glass carefully.
recommendations: Do not place broken glass loosely in bags.

name: Metal Can
description: Metal packaging commonly used for beverages and food.
recycling_details: Empty and rinse the can before placing it in the appropriate metal recycling collection.

name: Electronic Waste
description: Discarded electronic equipment such as mobile phones, computers, chargers and circuit boards.
recycling_details: Electronic waste should be taken to an authorized e-waste collection or recycling facility. Do not dispose of electronics with regular household waste.
recommendations: Repair or donate electronics when possible.

name: Battery
description: A device that stores electrical energy and is used in electronic equipment.
recycling_details: Batteries should be taken to an appropriate battery collection or e-waste facility. Do not place batteries in regular household waste.
recommendations: Keep damaged batteries away from heat and flames.
Do not throw batteries into regular garbage.

name: Used Clothes
description: Clothing that is no longer needed or suitable for regular use.
recycling_details: Donate usable clothing or send textiles to organizations and facilities that accept textile waste.
recommendations: Reuse old textiles as cleaning cloths.

name: Garden Waste
description: Organic waste such as leaves, grass, branches and plant material.
recycling_details: Garden waste can often be composted or processed into mulch.
recommendations: Compost leaves and suitable plant material.
Keep garden waste separate from plastic waste.

name: Used Cooking Oil
description: Cooking oil that has already been used for frying or food preparation.
recycling_details: Do not pour used cooking oil into drains. Store it safely and use an appropriate collection or recycling service where available.
recommendations: Never pour cooking oil into the sink.
Store used oil in a sealed container.
Use an authorized collection service when available.
suggestions: Reuse cooking oil only when safe and appropriate.
